name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: Fast-start parallel engineering orchestration with four Luna workers by default, safe token-first fallback, a shared operations leader, and token-free native status.

interface.shortDescription: Low-cost Luna work with visible Sol governance.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune's compact start_task fast path deterministically expands one Sol brief into a four-worker Luna/max burst, with custom batches as an advanced path and token-first as a safety fallback. Active workers use renewable liveness leases with no fixed execution cutoff, and idle slots immediately claim queued workstreams. Parallel writes use detached Git worktrees and deterministic safe-apply gates. One shared Luna/high operations leader judges sustained silence and compresses results while Sol retains planning, architecture, risk, integration review, and final acceptance. A native Windows panel shows token-free live status.
defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator fast start: send one compact engineering task and keep its default four-way parallel routing.
Use $luna-pool-orchestrator in token-first fallback mode because parallel write isolation is unsafe here.
